title: story/1
description: A delivery's story, as the narrator tells it from the journal: a digest, chapters that each end at a landing, the beats inside them with the altitudes each shows at, the threads that gather each setback, and a ledger that tells each setback once, grouped by story and reason. It holds instants and the durations between two entries, never a time measured to now.

state.description: Whether the delivery is still running or has closed.

ledger.description: Each setback once: one row per story, kind and reason, the standing rows first, each part newest first.

tones.description: What each tone means to a reader, in the order a legend lists them.

words.description: What a reader reads: a head and a line, in the page's voice.

digest.description: What the story holds: the pieces landed, when the delivery started and closed, its setbacks and what they cost, and the lead's decisions.

took.description: From the first entry to the close, once closed.

closed.description: The ledger rows that have ended.

cost.description: What the ended ledger rows cost, together.

standing.description: Each setback still open, by its thread and the instant it opened.

chapter.description: A stretch of the delivery: the start, up to its first landing; each landing, from the one before; and what came after the last.

subject.description: The piece that landed, for a landing.

at.description: The landing's instant; the first entry's for the start; the last entry's for the finish.

setbacks.description: The ledger rows that opened or ended inside this chapter.

standing.description: For each ledger row that opened in an earlier chapter and ended inside this one, the thread that ended it last. A row that opened inside this chapter is told here by its own beats, so it is not listed, and nothing still standing from an earlier chapter is carried into a later one.

notLanded.description: For a closed delivery's last chapter, the pieces that never landed.

standing.description: One line for each ledger row that opened in an earlier chapter and ended inside this one, at until, which a view shows as a time.

beat.description: One thing a reader reads: an entry, a batch's starts, a run of bookkeeping, finish lines met together, or a setback told whole at the headline altitude.

thread.description: The thread its entries belong to.

kind.description: Its entries' kind, or a thread's opening kind; none for a run of bookkeeping.

explain.description: One sentence on what its kind of event is, shown when the beat is opened; none for a run of bookkeeping.

items.description: For a run of bookkeeping, each of its entries in that entry's own words; empty otherwise.

thread.description: A setback: its opening, every entry linked to it, the entry that answered it, and what it cost.

beat.description: The beat that tells it at the headline altitude.

closing.description: The entry that ended it: one that answered its opening, or its story's landing.

cost.description: From its opening to its closing; none while it stands. A stop journalled after its story's landing happened ends at its own opening, at no cost.

endedBy.description: What ended it: an entry that answered its opening, or its own story's landing, which ends a stop nothing answered; none while it stands.

cause.description: What went wrong first: the problems its opening happened because of.

told.description: Its parts, each a sentence of its own: what went wrong first, its own line, what it held up, and how it ended or that it still stands.

said.description: The opening's own line: why it happened, when nothing earlier caused it.

ledgerRow.description: Setbacks with the same story, kind and reason, told once.

subject.description: The piece its setbacks name, if any.

reason.description: Its openings' reason, where they give one.

state.description: Open while any of its threads stands.

since.description: When its oldest standing thread opened; none once it has ended.

endedAt.description: When its last thread ended, once all have.

endedBy.description: The entry that ended its last thread.

ending.description: Whether that entry answered it or was its story's landing.

cost.description: Once ended, the time its threads held something up, overlaps counted once.

waitingOn.description: Who a standing row waits on, where the record says.

chapters.description: The chapter it opened in, and the one it ended in.
